reasons.plausibility: It invokes known temperature-driven microstructural changes but relies on a tenuous link between dislocation density, elastic modulus, and friction in an extremely thin film.
reasons.testability: Although a correlation-based verification is suggested, measuring dislocation densities and HCP fraction alongside friction at such high strain rates and temperatures in a 2-nm coating is challenging.
reasons.usefulness: It provides some mechanistic insights for high-temperature deformation and friction behavior, but the focus on uniaxial tensile MD simulations rather than actual sliding wear limits its direct applicability.
